title: ShipperTrackingListItem
description: One Transport Order in the list a Shipper gets from the Norvia Partner API's tracking operation (Shipper tracking format, version 1); the answer is an array of these, newest collection first. It follows the Shipper booking format: its own field names, flat address fields and local date/times, dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm. The ETA and the last update are local to the delivery address. The Shipper deals in Transport Orders, so it never names the Carrier or the Shipment number.

norviaOrderNo.description: Norvia's number of the Transport Order.

bookingRef.description: The Shipper's own reference of the booking. Absent when the Transport Order has none.

eta.description: The estimated time of arrival, local to the delivery address. Absent when there is none.

lastUpdate.description: The time of the latest progress event, local to the delivery address. Absent before collection.

status.description: Where the Transport Order stands. SCHEDULED covers everything before collection, so the Shipper can't tell Own fleet from a Carrier.

localDateTime.description: A local date and time as dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm (24-hour clock), in the time zone of the place it is about.
